outcome: Postpartum weight retention of 10 pounds or more at 1 year
cohort: 2500 first-time mothers, aged 18-35 with singleton pregnancies
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of postpartum weight retention of 10 pounds or more at 1 year postpartum, even after adjusting for confounders.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery at first childbirth is associated with increased risk of weight retention of 10 pounds or more at 1 year postpartum.
